answer: Identity-bond decay stops fake identities. Each identity locks a 60 POA bond decaying 5% per idle epoch unless refreshed by cipher-signed work, keeping its ember warm. Zephyr spot-checks sample a few identities each epoch; any bond below the floor loses its slots. Forging 100 identities costs 100 x 60 = 6,000 POA plus rework per ember, against 200 POA of rewards, a net loss near 3,800. An honest agent pays once and keeps its share undiluted.
